data.title: bn-26c: M1.5.6 Development fixture response modes for F-11 and F-42: compressed, escaped, oversized, truncated

data.reason: Reviewed 805d36d0d688976eea85a87e0e4243dbefafcadd through 3939fde64a1d027738491b2667dacac31524b34b. Orders.rs:123 and lib.rs:381 require exactly one valid admin secret for each selected mode and preserve session, order, fix-mode and no-store behavior. All seven raw HTTP/1.1 tests passed, including compressed payload decoding, transfer framing, nested escaped JSON, and incomplete Content-Length at EOF. Ground-truth.json:196 maps F-11/POR-08 and F-42/POR-09 to their fixture outcomes. The checked samples are 8,388,678 bytes for size and 1,111 bytes expanding to 1,048,646 bytes (943.88x) for ratio, with expected limit failures conditional on the future verifier configuration. Dependency-pin, oracle-contract and diff whitespace checks also passed.
